e: A bus plunges into the Bafing River, killing 24 people and injuring 36 others.
At least 59 people are killed in floods and landslides caused by torrential rain in Abidjan and Ghana.
The government dissolves the Independent Electoral Commission (CEI) following criticism from opposition parties and civil society groups over its independence and handling of elections.
China lifts tariffs on imports from Ivory Coast until 2028.
France returns a talking drum looted in 1916 at a ceremony in Abidjan, the first time it has repatriated a cultural artefact to Ivory Coast.
President Ouattara appoints Defence Minister Téné Birahima Ouattara as vice prime minister, while retaining his defence portfolio.
President Ouattara reappoints Robert Beugré Mambé as prime minister.
